snippet.title: The Hearth And Harbour Dev Update Trailer - Story Rich Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Saltstone Studios, the developers behind The Pale Beyond, go deeper into the development of their adventure management game, The Hearth & Harbour. Discover more about Kit Purcell, an immigrant fleeing his war-torn country and looking for a new life in Lewthport. Kit has invested in a restaurant, but in addition to managing it, he’ll need to build trust and form relationships with the locals.

Every day as Kit, you’ll go to market, buy ingredients and juggle your guests’ needs with your own stress as you provide service in the restaurant. Alternating between yourself and your trusty cook Cyril Reed, you’ll balance keeping customers happy, cooking their meals, and delivering their meals piping-hot.

After the day is done, you’re free to explore Lewthport and its many locations - you might even meet some of your customers you served throughout the day - or maybe potential new ones! Chat with them, get to know them and even invite them to your restaurant. While you’ll need to pay the rent, you’ll only be able to survive with the support of your friends and community.

Forging friendships will earn you Favour, which will help you solve the townsfolk’s problems or even cut deals with vendors - you can always use a discount when shopping for the day, after all! Your friends’ trust will earn you fancier recipes and gifts, which you can use to cook more expensive dishes and decorate your restaurant as you desire.

Wishlist the Hearth and Harbour now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2528170/The_Hearth_and_Harbour/
